blocks.text: KATHMANDU — Malaysian immigration authorities detained 472 undocumented migrant workers, including Filipinos and Nepalis, during a crackdown Sunday in the Kotaraya area of Kuala Lumpur. The operation targeted foreign workers who gathered in the area on their rest day for leisure and shopping. Immigration officers checked the documents of nearly 2,500 foreign nationals before making the arrests. Kuala Lumpur Immigration Director Datuk Hamsha Bin Injau said the operation began at around 11 a.m. and resulted in the arrest of 439 men and 33 women aged 18 to 62.
